facts.text: Snow left Harkness Flat (6,200 ft) 19 days earlier this year than the midpoint of two of the three earlier seasons on file (2024 and 2025).

evidence.name: Harkness Flat
evidence.detail: left April 24; earlier seasons: May 12 (2024), May 14 (2025); 2023: no readings on file

facts.text: At Rattlesnake (6,210 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 5.3 in, the lowest of three of the four seasons on file (2023, 2024 and 2026).

evidence.name: Rattlesnake
evidence.detail: 5.3 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 47.2 in (2023), 21.6 in (2024)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 22 and May 11, carried from the melt-out date at Harkness Flat (6,200 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Harkness Flat
evidence.detail: melted out April 24, 449 ft above the pass; points to March 22 to May 11
